mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Verona Area High School. Tonight, the moon is in its third quarter, and if you are up early, you can catch the space station at 3:35 AM as it rises over Verona High School in the northwest and travels toward Fitchburg, appearing halfway up the sky. Our overnight low will be 73 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The city has two big updates. First, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is moving forward to ensure year-round accessibility, with bridge work starting soon. Also, the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture, created from a reclaimed ash tree, is now on display at Century School Park for all to enjoy.

Today you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness, and tonight brings Hop Haus Trivia to town. Looking ahead, we have live music starting tomorrow at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on August 30, officers were dispatched to the 800 block of North Edge Trail after a vehicle window was intentionally smashed by an individual who fled the scene.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Snickers Swirl. The Culver's of Verona is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight, so stop by soon to grab a scoop.
